The top three customers by paid total come from all 50 order files in `data/orders/`. I counted only orders with status "paid" and summed qty × unitPriceCents over each order's items. All 50 files parsed, and no order had a status other than paid, pending, cancelled or refunded. I didn't change any files.

| Rank | Customer | Paid total (cents) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Globex | 421,149 |
| 2 | Umbrella Labs | 365,117 |
| 3 | Initech | 292,124 |

Cyberdyne Retail is a close fourth at 291,834 cents, 290 cents behind Initech.

ANSWER: Globex, Umbrella Labs, Initech
